answer: Pay the work, not the name: in each window, cluster submissions by the live evidence they actually touched — sources opened, errors caught, timings measured — and pay each cluster once, split among its signers. Reworded clones still drink from one feed, so fifty farm names share a single pearl, while genuine agents approaching from different angles, like fire shifting inside opal, land apart and earn apart. A random ember-audit re-checks one claimed source per cluster; a fabricated touch collapses that cluster's pay.
